proposed_widenings.name: Duration.permanent
proposed_widenings.justification: Sequester has duration 'permanent, ends on dispel or damage taken'. The current Duration union has instantaneous | concentration | timed. None of these map to a permanent effect with no scheduled expiry — 'timed' requires a DurationValue with a unit/amount, which doesn't exist for 'until dispelled'. A new variant { kind: 'permanent' } is needed, optionally with a list of early-end triggers (damage, dispel).

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.apply_conditions
proposed_widenings.justification: Sequester's core operation is applying a set of conditions (Invisible, Unconscious) to the attachment target for the duration. The current OngoingOperation union only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit. A new variant is needed to represent 'apply these conditions to the attachment while the spell persists'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "the target has the Invisible condition" and "it has the Unconscious condition"

proposed_widenings.name: Condition: 'invisible' | 'unconscious'
proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type is currently closed at 'prone' only. Sequester applies both Invisible and Unconscious. These are standard SRD conditions that will recur across many spells and features. The type must be widened to include them (and likely the full SRD condition list).
proposed_widenings.evidence: "the target has the Invisible condition" / "it has the Unconscious condition"

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.block_detection
proposed_widenings.justification: Sequester blocks the target from being 'targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic'. The v4 atom block_targeting covers this, but no surface OngoingOperation variant exposes it. A new variant is needed to represent anti-divination / anti-detection shielding as a persistent operation on an attachment.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "can't be targeted by Divination spells, detected by magic, or viewed remotely with magic"

notes: The family is ongoing_effect — Sequester is a permanent buff/debuff applied to a touched target. The structural fit is correct; only surface-type variants are missing. The caster-defined end condition ('anything you choose, as long as it occurs within 1 mile') is open-ended DM-adjudicated prose and intentionally left out of core mechanics encoding — it is not expressible in a closed grammar. The 'suspended animation' physiological effects (no aging, no food/water/air) are caller-owned narrative facts per ARCHITECTURE.md and are likewise excluded from core mechanics. The core deterministic atoms (apply_condition ×2, block_targeting, persist) all exist in v4. All gaps are surface-shape variants, not missing atoms.
